```yaml
name: E2E Tests (Playwright)

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  e2e-playwright:
    name: E2E Tests (Playwright)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      checks: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox

      - name: Build packages
        run: yarn build

      - name: Build website examples
        run: yarn website:examples

      - name: Run Playwright E2E tests
        run: yarn test:e2e
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30

  e2e-nextjs:
    name: E2E Tests (Next.js)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      checks: write
      pull-requests: write
    strategy:
      matrix:
        router: [app, pages]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install Playwright Browsers
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox

      - name: Build packages
        run: yarn build

      - name: Run Next.js E2E tests (${{ matrix.router }} router)
        run: yarn test:e2e:nextjs:${{ matrix.router }}
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Upload Playwright report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report-nextjs-${{ matrix.router }}
          path: playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30

  e2e-ie11:
    name: E2E Tests (IE11 via Sauce Labs)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      checks: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages
        run: yarn build

      - name: Build website examples
        run: yarn website:examples

      - name: Run IE11 E2E tests (WebdriverIO)
        run: yarn test:e2e:ie11
        env:
          SAUCE_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SAUCE_USERNAME }}
          SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.SAUCE_ACCESS_KEY }}
          CI: true

  all-green:
    name: All E2E Tests Passed
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - e2e-playwright
      - e2e-nextjs
      - e2e-ie11
    if: always()
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check all jobs passed
        uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
```
